comment: A real sunrise over the sea (the Umhlanga Sunrise HDRI of Poly Haven, CC0, not in the repository for its size: put its 16k .hdr in assets/env/polyhaven/) photographed through the double-Gauss at f/8 with seven blades: the star of the sun is the aperture's diffraction, the ghosts are the light the coated lens surfaces reflect twice (docs/CAMERA.md).
